chapter: Tra La La and the Griffin Brothers
title: Writing Tra La La and the Decca release
summary: How he wrote Tra La La, the T-Gym flip, Bartholomew's name on the label, and the Deluxe dispute that sent him to New York.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
